chapterInfo.content:
9
Afrafra awadeɛ. Esra ahonu mpaebɔ
1Na wɔwiee yeinom no, mmapɔmma no baa me nkyɛn sɛ: Israel man ne asɔfoɔ ne Lewifoɔ no ntee wɔn ho mfirii nsase so aman sɛ: Kanaanfoɔ, Hetifoɔ, Perisifoɔ, Yebusifoɔ, Amonfoɔ, Moabfoɔ, Misraimfoɔ ne Amorifoɔ akyiwadeɛ ho, 2#Esra 9.11-12; Neh 13.23 ɛfiri sɛ wɔafefa wɔn mmammaa mu bi, na wɔne wɔn mma awareware wɔn, na yɛn asefoɔ kronkron no de wɔn ho akɔfrafra nsase no so aman no mu. Na mmapɔmma ne amampanin no na ɛdi mmarato yi mu kan. 3#Gye 37.34 Na metee asɛm yi no, mesunsuanee m’atadeɛ ne me batakari mu, na metutuu me tirinwi ne me bɔgyesɛ, na mede ahodwirie metenaa ase. 4Na wɔn a Israel Nyankopɔn nsɛm yɛɛ wɔn ahopopoɔ, atukɔfoɔ no mmarato nti no nyinaa boaboaa wɔn ano baa me nkyɛn, na me deɛ, mede ahodwirie metenaa hɔ ara kɔsii anwummerɛ afɔrebɔ berɛ.
5Na anwummerɛ afɔrebɔ mu no, mesɔre firii m’awerɛhoɔ no mu, nso na masunsuane m’atadeɛ ne me batakari mu, na mekotoo me nankoroma anim metrɛɛ me nsam mekyerɛɛ AWURADE me Nyankopɔn 6#Dan 9.7-8; Dwom 38.4 sɛ:
Me Nyankopɔn, m’ani awu na ɛyɛ me fɛre sɛ mɛma m’ani so makyerɛ woɔ, me Nyankopɔn, ɛfiri sɛ yɛn amumuyɛ adɔɔso atra yɛn ti, na yɛn asodie aso akɔduru ɔsoro. 7Ɛfiri yɛn agyanom berɛ soɔ no, asodie kɛseɛ mu na yɛwɔ ara de abɛduru nnɛ yi, na yɛn amumuyɛ no nti wɔayi yɛn, yɛn ahemfo ne yɛn asɔfoɔ ahyɛ nsase so ahemfo nsa wɔ afena, nnommumfa, ɔfomfa ne animguaseɛ mu, sɛdeɛ ɛte nnɛ yi. 8#Yes 22.23 Na afei seesei nko ara na wɔayi AWURADE yɛn Nyankopɔn hɔ adom akyerɛ yɛn, ama wɔagya yɛn nkaeɛ a wɔafiri mu afire, nanso wɔama yɛn pɛɛwa wɔ ne kronkronbea, sɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn bɛte yɛn anim na wama yɛanya nkwa kakra, yɛn nkoayɛ mu. 9#Yes 5.5 Na yɛyɛ nkoa, nanso yɛn nkoayɛ mu no yɛn Nyankopɔn nnyaa yɛn, na mmom wama Persia ahemfo ayɛ yɛn adɔeɛ. Na yɛanya ahoɔden a yɛde si yɛn Nyankopɔn fie, na yɛnkyekyere n’akurofo, na wɔmma yɛn ɔfasuo bi wɔ Yuda ne Yerusalem.
10Na afei, ɛdeɛn na yɛnka, yɛn Nyankopɔn, yei akyi? Sɛ yɛagya wo mmara nsɛm no 11#Lew 18.24-25 a wonam wo nkoa adiyifoɔ no soɔ hyɛeɛ sɛ: Asase a morekɔ akɔdi soɔ no yɛ asase a ɛho akum, nsase so aman figuo no mu, wɔ akyiwadeɛ a wɔde ayɛ so ma, firi ano akɔpem ano, wɔn afideɛ mu no nti. 12#Deut 7.2-3 Na afei mommfa mo mmammaa mmma wɔn mmammarima, na monnnye wɔn mmammaa mmma mo mmammarima, na monnhwehwɛ wɔn ɔmannwoeɛ ne wɔn yiedie ara da, deɛ ɛbɛyɛ na mo ho bɛyɛ den na moadi asase no so nnepa, na mode agya mo mma ma wɔadi so akɔsi daa. 13Na deɛ yɛn nneyɛɛ bɔne ne yɛn asodie kɛseɛ nti ɛbaa yɛn soɔ no nyinaa akyiri yi nso, wo, yɛn Nyankopɔn, woadi yɛn ho adɔna, woamma no annuru yɛn amumuyɛ so, na woama yɛafiri mu sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ yi, 14yɛnsane mmu wo mmara nsɛm so na yɛmfa yɛn ho nkɔbɔ akyiwadeɛ aman yi ho wɔ awadeɛ mu anaa? Anka wo bo remfu yɛn nkɔsi sɛ yɛn nyinaa bɛsa a obi renka mfiri mu anaa? 15#Neh 9.33 AWURADE, Israel Nyankopɔn, ɔteneneeni ne wo, ɛfiri sɛ wɔagya yɛn nkaeɛ bi a wɔafiri mu sɛdeɛ ɛte nnɛ yi; hwɛ, yɛwɔ w’anim, yɛn asodie mu. Na yei nti obiara biara rentumi nnyina w’anim.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
